methodologyNotes: Covers 14 heavy punching bags a 2026 buyer actually cross-shops: freestanding water/sand-base towers (Everlast PowerCore, Century Wavemaster XXL and Original, Everlast Omniflex, RDX F6 Kara) and traditional hanging bags spanning budget synthetic (Outslayer #02, TITLE Classic Challenger, Ringside Powerhide), Muay Thai banana/teardrop styles (Fairtex HB6, Ringside Powerhide Thai), water-filled (Aqua Training Bag 21"), and premium leather (Everlast 1910 Pro, TITLE Professional Choice). Every product was independently re-verified 2026-08-01 against the manufacturer's own product page (everlast.com, centurymartialarts.com, ringside.com, titleboxing.com, outslayer.com, fairtex.com, rdxsports.com, aquatrainingbag.com), fetched directly. priceUsd is the manufacturer-listed US starting price (current sale price where a bag is on sale, regular MSRP otherwise); it is never averaged or estimated. bag_weight_lb is the bag's own filled/rated weight for hanging bags; it is null for freestanding units, which are rated by base_capacity_lb (how much water or sand the base holds) instead — the two specs are mutually exclusive by design (freestanding=true implies bag_weight_lb=null and vice versa). diameter_in is the bag's own striking-surface diameter (not the wider freestanding base plate, which is called out in provenance when published separately, e.g. Century XXL's 18in bag on a 28in base). height_in is a string where a bag has an adjustable/telescoping range (e.g. "54–65") and a plain number for fixed-height hanging bags. mounting_type describes how a hanging bag attaches (chain+swivel vs sewn straps) or states 'freestanding base' for self-supporting units. Corrections made during verification: the RDX F6 Kara's base capacity (120kg sand / 80L water, ~265lb) is published only for the sibling 5ft SKU, not the 6ft model actually priced here, so base_capacity_lb is left null rather than assumed transferable; the Everlast 'Nevatear' bag is a genuinely live but currently sold-out SKU (Platinum/Black Nevatear Heavy Punching Bag) whose site displayed a single $34.99–$49.99 price band that could not be reliably attributed to the 60lb vs. 70lb variant, so priceUsd is left null rather than guessed; Fairtex's frequently-repeated '14.17in x 70.87in' HB6 dimension figure could not be re-traced to a citable source during this pass and was dropped rather than included unsourced. All accessedAt dates are 2026-08-01.

products.name: Everlast PowerCore Freestanding Heavy Bag
products.priceNote: MSRP as listed on everlast.com, SKU 009283595081
products.provenance: Official Everlast product page confirms: air-foam chamber design, PowerCore power-transfer ring, high-density base fillable with water (~250 lb) or sand (~370 lb), height adjustable 54"–65", $229.99 price. Cross-checked against the punching-bags-stands collection listing, which shows the same $229.99. No outer cover material or bag diameter is published on either page, so both are left null rather than guessed; no release year is stated.

products.name: Century XXL Wavemaster
products.priceNote: MSRP per centurymartialarts.com (Black colorway); Red colorway on centurymartialarts.ca lists CAD, not used for USD figure
products.provenance: Official Century product page (Black) confirms 69" total height, 18" bag diameter, 18oz vinyl cover over high-density foam, 270 lb sand/water base capacity, $399.99. Century Canada's Red-colorway listing corroborates the identical 69"-tall / 18"-diameter / 270 lb-base specs verbatim ('69 inches tall and a full 18 inches in diameter') but prices in CAD, so only the US site's $399.99 is used. The base itself is a separate, wider 28" plate (stated on the .ca page) distinct from the 18" bag diameter recorded here. No release year is published.

products.name: Century Wavemaster
products.priceNote: MSRP per centurymartialarts.com; the classic/original freestanding Wavemaster (distinct from the 2XL, XXL, Triad and Uppercut variants Century also sells)
products.provenance: Official Century product page confirms seven height adjustments from 47" to 68", 18oz heavy-duty vinyl cover ('minimal stretch, easy to clean'), high-density foam fill, rounded relocatable base fillable with sand or water (~250 lb stated for water; sand capacity not separately quantified on this page), $199.99. Century's own Wavemaster collection page describes this specific model as 'the original freestanding bag' among the wider Wavemaster line. Bag diameter is not published on the manufacturer page, so left null rather than estimated; no release year stated (the Wavemaster line dates to the 1980s per Century's marketing copy, but no specific year is given for this current SKU).

products.name: Fairtex HB6 6FT Muay Thai Banana Bag

specs.filling_type: unfilled as shipped (ships empty; approx. 86 lb / 39 kg once filled)

Mounting hardware (top strap/loop) and bag diameter are not stated on the page and are left null rather than assumed; a widely-repeated '14.17in x 70.87in' dimension figure for this model could not be re-traced to a citable source during this pass and was omitted. products.priceNote: Unresolved: everlast.com (SKU 009283595104) showed a single $34.99 sale / $49.99 regular price band across the product's 60lb and 70lb size options while both were marked sold out, and the figure could not be reliably attributed to the 70lb size specifically, so left null rather than guessed
